observation.command: cd /workspace; echo "== php ldap ext =="; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev exec php -m' 2>&1 | grep -iE 'ldap|pdo_mysql|mysqli' ; echo "== app pages =="; for p in / /dokumentation /administration/it-gesamtplan /administration/benutzerverwaltung/alle-dienststellen /administration/dienststellen; do code=$(curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site$p"); echo "$p -> $code"; done; echo "== login page =="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "login=%{http_code}\n" http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/login
